feed.headline: Russian arrested for spying on US defence company Palantir over Ukraine support
feed.ai: The suspect followed employees and was found with fake US IDs and two Russian passports, prosecutors say.

feed.headline: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
feed.ai: The three leaders will meet together for the first time on Thursday during a closely-watched summit.

feed.headline: Budget Fiat 500s complete 4,000km Rome challenge
feed.ai: Stuart Bailey and a group of men took £500 Fiats from Heathrow to Rome in three days, raising £13,000.

feed.headline: Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board
feed.ai: Russia's defence ministry says it preliminarily believes a technical malfunction was the cause of the crash in the Kemerovo region.

feed.headline: Who to watch in Spain's election race
feed.ai: Spain votes on 29 November, with the conservatives leading most polls after eight years of Socialist-led rule.

feed.headline: The EU that Burnham is eyeing up is very different to the one Britain left
feed.ai: Andy Burnham wants "steps" towards a closer EU alignment. But the bloc has changed considerably since the UK left it

feed.headline: Trump says he and Putin have a 'great relationship' at meeting
feed.ai: US President Donald Trump has met Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (Apec) summit in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen.

feed.headline: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
feed.ai: Watch: The BBC's Jonathan Beale joins Ukrainian forces taking the battle below ground and out of sight of Russian drones.

feed.headline: Putin, Trump and Xi Condemn Nuclear War as Europe Watches Closely
feed.ai: After their summit, the leaders of Russia, the United States and China agreed that “a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought.” Some analysts are skeptical that real change will result.

feed.headline: After Deadly Train Crash, Spain Asks: Did It Grow Too Much, Too Quickly?
feed.ai: As an election nears, a railway disaster in Spain has set off debate over whether maintenance of its infrastructure kept pace with its booming population.

feed.headline: ECB President Christine Lagarde on Why She’s Stepping Down Early
feed.ai: The president of the European Central Bank said she wanted to use her voice and decades of experience against what she said was “fake news” and “misrepresentations” in European elections.

feed.headline: The Shadow of Yalta Hangs Over Trump’s Summit in China
feed.ai: A 1945 meeting of Churchill, Stalin and Franklin Roosevelt set Europe’s course for decades. Here’s what happened.
